notes.title: v1.2.0 Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello!

I am pleased to annouce that Pingers version 1.2.0 has just been released with some new features/treats to get stuck in to!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
1. Added a new feature which switches players to a different position when playing with 2 or more players.
2. Added reacts (text and icons) which occur at the start of games, when players pickup certain items, when players miss or get hit by an enemy or when players press the action key (e/enter on keyboard or the a button on a controller)
3. Tweet your score. At the end of a round players can choose to tweet their highest score.
4. Added two new ball types which will stick around in play for a lot longer.
5. Tweaked game difficulty based on feedback.
6. Added three new achievements: 1000 points, gluck rookie and gluck master.
7. Added a new "repel" item in versus mode which will block all balls in a certain radius without destroying them.
8. Tweaked AI so that they better handle enemy bullets and return to the centre after hitting balls.
9. Added two new face unlocks.
10. The game will now pause after a controller is disconnected.
11. Fixed powerups cooldown not restarting when you pick up the same powerup twice. This means powerups will last longer.
12. Fixed a ball spawning bug which caused more balls to spawn than necessary.

George

[i]Please join our discord server [url=https://discord.com/invite/pnAn6WkDPp]here [/url]to stay up-to-date[/i]

notes.title: v1.0.0 Update!
notes.content:
[i]Please join our discord server [url=https://discord.gg/pnAn6WkDPp]here[/url] to stay up-to-date
[/i]
Hello hello! Its been a long time since I posted an update. I have been heads down working on Pingers ahead of the release at the end of next month (29th July) 🙌

I am very happy to say that Pingers is now ready, version 1.0.0 is primed for release on the 29th July! 😻

The biggest changes since the last update are:

1. New game mode, versus mode.
2. CPU players
3. More tracks
4. Steam achievements
5. Steam leaderboards
6. Localisation

[h2]VERSUS MODE[/h2]

You can now choose what game mode to play after selecting "Play" in the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/07aa59d8c9fc79795e11dab63ea3902949dc4bda.png[/img]

Once you have selected a mode, you then pick how many players you want to play with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/08085061126d9e732af8f7e4c9d3401eef5c0578.png[/img]

After you've confirmed the player count, you can pick your characters as normal. The big change here is that now you can play with CPU players, or you can join in with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/e33a970ce877ff762f390f2cfd2560a304a08551.png[/img]

Once a player dies, e.g. they run out of lives (this number can be changed in the game difficulty settings) they will be replaced with a wall. Below you can see a 4 player game where 3 players have died, leaving one player and 3 walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/d634881385c8c06257b77fbdf3fb2d35f99183be.png[/img]

Once the last player dies, they win the game and are shown the new winning screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/16179edabc7e164e6ff54768679f2c1319f0d80b.png[/img]

You can change the number of lives in the game difficulty settings as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39824417/3daed00df343aaad8a096f6d791def8f7e4b2bf0.png[/img]

If you want to know more about Pingers ahead of the release, please join our discord server here: https://discord.com/invite/HnkwyAm9 

Please consider adding Pingers to your wishlist to stay up-to-date!

George.

notes.title: v0.0.5 Update Released!
notes.content:
It's weekly update time and I've just released version 0.0.5 of Pingers to Steam!

I've made some big progress this week with the sound for the game. Pingers now has 2 new tracks, one for the ingame menus and the other for the game itself. Check out the latest version to hear the new music! As well as this, I have also added a plethora of much needed sound effects to the game, finally!

On the visual side I have two topics to call out, a new menu background and the options menu which you can see below.

[h3]New menu background[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/cTgdUZfXAKTEMAWDYt/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Options menu![/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jmBKL5YeH4gFb1iThf/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Other notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when unlocking all the hats which was crashing the game
[*] Tweaked the powerup spawn rate from 10 seconds to 6 seconds
[*] Changed the ramp up of difficulty so that the game gets harder faster
[*] Fixed control mapping when using multiple controllers so that players have sensible controls!
[*] Attempted to add more sophisticated error reporting, but ran into SSL issues, to be revisited
[*] Created new steam store and library assets, updated with the new look and feel of the game
[/list]

[h3]Whats coming up?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] New faces and hats!
[/list]

As always if you have any feedback please hit me up on Twitter or use the game discussions in Steam. I really appreciate everyone that has been playing and providing feedback so please keep it coming!

[h3]BETA TEST[/h3]

If you want to beta test Pingers (thanks to everyone who has been playing so far) you can sign up using [url=https://forms.gle/HVSgwB9a3anatBqu8]this google form [/url] or by sending me a DM on [url=https://twitter.com/allengames_]twitter here[/url]

notes.title: v0.0.4 Update Released!
notes.content:
[i]If you want to beta test Pingers (thanks to everyone who has been playing so far) you can sign up [url=https://forms.gle/qwaRH76SdnWWgVMFA]using this google form[/url] or by sending me a DM on [url=https://twitter.com/allengames_]twitter here[/url][/i]

Hello again! Its weekly update time and I have just realsed version 0.0.4 of Pingers! As always, some new treats to get your teeth into.

This week was all about player customisation and building the foundations for the unlock system within the game. With this there are two [i][b]major[/b][/i] changes.

Players can now choose a hat, and a face for their paddle in the player select screen! New hats and faces can be unlocked by playing the game and scoring new points. This has added a number of new concepts which I will cover below.

[h3]Player customisation[/h3]

On the player picker screen, players can now change three elements. Their paddle colour, face and hat. You can see this in action below:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UK5pwCYyQZmg8WQmOA/giphy.gif[/img]

If an item is not yet unlocked, it will show a padlock on top of the item, unlocking these is described below.

[h3]Unlocking new items[/h3]

When a player unlocks a new item, once they have scored enough points to get that item, they will see the following:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UYEY8LwtW4SiIZfm1Z/giphy.gif[/img]

If you note, that once they get to the game over screen, they will also see how many points away from the next item they are.

[h3]Other notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed macos steam integration. This was causing issues for a number of players
[*] Fixed issues with screen effects rendering over paddles
[/list]

[h3]Whats coming up?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] New items and attacks
[*] Game sounds and more music
[/list]

[h3]BETA TEST[/h3]

If you want to beta test Pingers (thanks to everyone who has been playing so far) you can sign up [url=https://forms.gle/qwaRH76SdnWWgVMFA]using this google form[/url] or by sending me a DM on [url=https://twitter.com/allengames_]twitter here[/url]

notes.title: v0.0.3 Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I have just released Pingers version 0.0.3 for testing. I have been working on this version during the week and have some [b]new treats[/b] for you all.

I have added [b]two[/b] new items, the [b]missile[/b] attack and a [b]freeze[/b] item. As well as finally adding the [b]stats screen[/b] at the end of the game so players can compare how well they did against eachother. Details below!

[h3]Missile Attack[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/AQnJfBM42M4dvuCoh0/giphy.gif[/img]

This adds a new item which once picked up will give the player a homing missile attack which will shoot at the closest ball possible. It lasts for 10 seconds.

[h3]Freeze[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/NHdon6KqanIKEPz46E/giphy.gif[/img]

Another new item, which once picked up will freeze all the balls on screen and once they defrost they will all pop!

[h3]Stats[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/F183343IPbc3k8oErT/giphy.gif[/img]

At the end of the game, you can now view stats for all the players!

[h3]Other Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for 4 player
[*] Fixed a bug with screen effects on the pause menu
[*] Fixed a memory issue relating to particle effects not being cleaned up
[/list]

[h3]What's coming up?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player customisation!
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] New items and attacks
[/list]

Thanks for reading ♥️

If you have any questions or just want to say hi, please reach out on [url=https://twitter.com/allengames_]Twitter[/url] or via email (george@allengames.io)

George
Allen Games
